Subject: Intro — strong referral (Riya S.) — candidate for Full‑stack SWE

Hi Dylan + Laura,

Quick intro — Riya Srinivasan (cc'd) was a teammate at her last company and comes highly recommended for a full‑stack SWE role on Search. She has solid backend experience (Go/Python), built production UI features in React, and shipped a performance optimization that reduced latency by ~30%.

I ran a quick bar-raiser screen and think she should move to an on‑site panel. Riya is actively interviewing but asked me to prioritize Redwood because of the platform work here.

Attached: Riya_Srinivasan_Resume.pdf and a portfolio link (Riya_Portfolio_Link.txt).

Suggested next steps / asks:
- Can we assign an owner to coordinate scheduling and interviewers?
- Preferred interviewers: Laura (backend), Dylan (system design), 1 IC from Search infra (I can recommend one).
- Candidate availability (Riya): next Tue–Thu afternoons (see her email).

Laura / Dylan — do you want to own the scheduling? If not, happy to have Dylan take lead and Laura drive debrief.

Thanks,

— Marissa

I'll make this tidy: Laura, can you own scheduling and own the debrief after interviews? I can sit on the system design panel (30–45m). If you're swamped, I can do ownership and loop in Recruiting.

- Laura: please coordinate with Riya for slots and lock a 90m panel (3 × 30m) next week if possible. Candidate said Tue–Thu afternoons — please propose concrete times.
- Marissa: can you share a one‑pager on the referral notes (interview focus areas + red flags)?
- Riya: thanks for considering Redwood — are you OK with a remote panel (Google Meet)?

Dylan

Hi Riya — nice to meet you over email, and thanks Marissa for the intro.

We'd love to schedule a 90‑minute remote panel for the Full‑stack SWE role. Based on your note, can you confirm availability for any of these windows next week (all times PT):
- Tue 2027‑08‑31 13:30–15:00 PT
- Wed 2027‑09‑01 14:00–15:30 PT
- Thu 2027‑09‑02 13:30–15:00 PT

If none of those work, please send two alternatives and we'll do our best to accommodate. I'll follow up with calendar invites and interviewer names once you confirm.

Pre‑read for the panel: please expect 30m system design, 30m coding (take‑home style live coding), 30m culture/team fit. You can see a short note on format here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1InterviewGuideExample

Thanks — Laura
